assessments.reasoning:
Economic maintenance is captured separately at the individual member level across labor income (Cuestionario Individual, Section 8) and non-labor income (Cuestionario de Hogar, Bloque VI, which records component number and name for each income source).
Labor burden is not fully captured: while paid work hours are recorded at the individual level (Cuestionario Individual, Section 3e), unpaid domestic work is only captured categorically by identifying who does most tasks or helps (Cuestionario de Hogar, Bloque VII, P. 1-2) without recording hours spent on unpaid domestic or care work.
Property and asset control (dwelling tenure) is recorded at the household level as a collective unit property (Cuestionario de Hogar, Bloque II, P. 7) rather than at the individual member level.
Decision-making spheres (such as daily consumption, child-rearing, or major financial choices) are not included anywhere in the instruments.
